capabilities: search vault files and attachments instantly, with file-type and extension filters
jump directly to matched headings and title properties from search results
display recent, bookmarked, and periodic notes below the search bar
customize logo, title, and interactive particle effects
embed the search bar or file lists into notes via a search-bar code block
extras: Very detailed settings documentation covering particle rendering, layouts, and search styles; also installable via BRAT. Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: A continuation of the Home tab plugin by olrenso, with ongoing updates and new features built on top of it.
problem: New Obsidian tabs start empty, with no launch page for quickly searching files, resuming recent notes, or jumping to bookmarks.
